name: hud_layout_hw_release_images
description: HudLayoutHW::ReleaseImages releases and clears the hardware layout 320/400-line variant overlay images.
known_limits: Tier C first; the existing VC target hud_layout_hw_release_images covers this function but may be blocked by the current zhud_ui.cpp VC compile issue.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x413080 validate ReleaseIfNotDefault calls for widget1Image320, widget1Image400, widget2Image320, and widget2Image400, followed by clearing those four pointers in reverse field order.
0x46d5a0 zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault is functionally equivalent and tier S under target zvid_image_release_helpers.

The native hardware layout release-images smoke calls ReleaseImages with populated variant image fields and verifies all four variant image pointers are cleared while unrelated widget state is preserved.
